values: 对3格矩形范围的敌人造成大量伤害。
Frieren deals heavy damage to enemies in a 3-tile rectangular area.
芙莉莲移动至尽可能最靠后的能覆盖最多敌人的位置，对3格矩形范围的敌人发射持续3秒的魔法攻击，每秒对范围内的敌人造成220% + 30% ATK伤害，并附带1400% + 180% ATK的真实伤害，真实伤害的部分由命中的所有敌人分摊。

Frieren moves to the rearmost position that maximizes the number of enemies her Ultimate can hit. The Ultimate strikes enemies in a 3-tile rectangular area for 3s, dealing 220% + 30% ATK damage per second and 1400% + 180% ATK true damage evenly split among all enemies hit.
每秒造成的伤害提升至240% + 30% ATK，附带的真实伤害提升至1500% + 180% ATK。
Increases damage per second to 240% + 30% ATK, and the extra true damage to 1500% + 180% ATK.
每秒造成的伤害提升至260% + 30% ATK，附带的真实伤害提升至1600% + 180% ATK。
Increases damage per second to 260% + 30% ATK, and the extra true damage to 1600% + 180% ATK.
每秒造成的伤害提升至280% + 30% ATK，附带的真实伤害提升至1700% + 180% ATK。
Increases damage per second to 280% + 30% ATK, and the extra true damage to 1700% + 180% ATK.
每秒造成的伤害提升至300% + 30% ATK，附带的真实伤害提升至1800% + 180% ATK。
Increases damage per second to 300% + 30% ATK, and the extra true damage to 1800% + 180% ATK.
在战斗开始时隐藏魔力，在一段时间后提升魔力输出并提升自己造成的伤害，随后使用“破灭之雷魔法”替代普通攻击，造成更高的伤害和控制效果。

When a battle starts, Frieren conceals her magic. After a short time, she amplifies her magic power, increasing her damage and replacing her normal attack with Lightning: Judradjim, which deals higher damage and can stun enemies.

战斗开始时，芙莉莲限制魔力，该状态下自己不会被敌人优先选为目标。在第15秒时，芙莉莲永久提升魔力输出，退出不被敌人优先选为目标的状态，使自身造成的伤害提升60%，并使用“破灭之雷魔法”替代普通攻击。“破灭之雷魔法”会对敌人造成3段220% + 25% ATK的伤害，最后一段伤害还会附带0.5秒的眩晕效果。在与辛美尔并肩作战5秒后，芙莉莲无视条件提升魔力输出，并且额外永久提升等同于辛美尔30%初始攻击力的攻击力。

When a battle starts, Frieren conceals her magic, making enemies less likely to target her. 15s into the battle, she amplifies her magic power, increasing her damage dealt by 60%, replacing her normal attack with Lightning: Judradjim, and no longer being a low-priority target for enemies.
Lightning: Judradjim strikes an enemy 3 times, each hit dealing 220% + 25% ATK damage, and the final hit stuns the target for 0.5s.
After fighting alongside Himmel for 5s, Frieren immediately amplifies her magic power, ignoring the time restriction, and gains a permanent ATK bonus equal to 30% of Himmel's initial ATK.
“破灭之雷魔法”每段对敌人造成的伤害提升至230% + 25% ATK。
Increases Lightning: Judradjim's damage per hit to 230% + 25% ATK.
“破灭之雷魔法”每段对敌人造成的伤害提升至240% + 25% ATK。
Increases Lightning: Judradjim's damage per hit to 240% + 25% ATK.
“破灭之雷魔法”每段对敌人造成的伤害提升至250% + 25% ATK。
Increases Lightning: Judradjim's damage per hit to 250% + 25% ATK.
使1格范围的敌人持续流失生命，并降低敌人的受愈。提升魔力输出后本技能释放频率提升。
Frieren causes continuous HP loss and reduces the Vitality of the target and adjacent enemies. After amplifying her magic power, she casts this skill more frequently.
芙莉莲释放“地狱业火魔法”，对半径1格范围内的所有敌人造成300% + 30% ATK伤害，并持续燃烧目标区域，持续5秒。燃烧期间，范围内的敌人每0.5秒流失35% ATK生命并降低20 + 5点受愈。在提升魔力输出后，本技能的冷却时间降低50%。

Frieren casts Hellfire: Vollzanbel, dealing 300% + 30% ATK damage to the target and adjacent enemies and burning the area for 5s. Enemies in the burning area lose 35% ATK HP every 0.5s, and their Vitality is reduced by 20 + 5. After Frieren amplifies her magic power, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 50%.
“地狱业火魔法”使敌人降低的受愈提升至30 + 5点。
Reduces the Vitality of enemies burned by Hellfire: Vollzanbel by 30 + 5.
“地狱业火魔法”使敌人降低的受愈提升至40 + 5点。
Reduces the Vitality of enemies burned by Hellfire: Vollzanbel by 40 + 5.
“地狱业火魔法”使敌人降低的受愈提升至50 + 5点。
Reduces the Vitality of enemies burned by Hellfire: Vollzanbel by 50 + 5.
战斗中，芙莉莲提升9%攻击力，在提升魔力输出后额外提升6%攻击力。
Frieren increases her ATK by 9% during battle. After amplifying her magic power, she increases her ATK by an extra 6%.
战斗中，芙莉莲提升12%攻击力，在提升魔力输出后额外提升8%攻击力。
Frieren increases her ATK by 12% during battle. After amplifying her magic power, she increases her ATK by an extra 8%.
战斗中，芙莉莲提升15%攻击力，在提升魔力输出后额外提升10%攻击力。
Frieren increases her ATK by 15% during battle. After amplifying her magic power, she increases her ATK by an extra 10%.
使自身和最靠前一名友军降低所受到的伤害。
Frieren reduces damage taken by herself and the frontmost ally.
战斗开始时，芙莉莲为自身和最靠前的一名友军施展防御魔法，当他们受到超过其10%初始最大生命值的伤害时，会使超出部分的伤害降低75%。
When a battle starts, Frieren casts defensive magic on herself and the frontmost ally. When either takes damage exceeding 10% of their initial max HP, the excess damage is reduced by 75%.
超出部分的伤害降低比例提升至80%。
The excess damage is reduced by 80%.
最靠前的这名友军存活期间，芙莉莲额外提升35点急速。
While the frontmost ally remains alive, Frieren increases her Haste by 35.
超出部分的伤害降低比例提升至85%。
The excess damage is reduced by 85%.
击飞累积造成伤害最高的敌人并使其倒地。
Frieren knocks the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt into the air before knocking them down.
提升魔力输出后第5秒，芙莉莲将累积造成伤害最高的敌人击飞到战场边缘，对其造成800% ATK伤害并使其倒地，持续2秒。

5s after Frieren amplifies her magic power, she knocks the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt into the air and hurls them toward the edge of the battlefield, dealing 800% ATK damage and knocking them down for 2s.
